## Proposal
Artificial Intelligence is becoming more common in mental health care. AI has and can be used in the world of digital mental health tools to help with providing information, support and other interventions. D'Alfonso @dalfonso2020 explains that mental health chatbots can be useful because they are availible at times other resources are not. They are also useful for people who are uncomfortable using traditional mental health services or don't have access to them. But, AI chatbots do have their limits to what they can really do. Their responses may not always be reliable or safe for someone going through something serious.
